title: Understanding Training and Validation Errors
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it often indicates a change in the model's complexity. Consider how the model's ability to generalize to new data might be affected by the number of features used.

title: Model Complexity and Variance
text: Think about how adding more features to a model can affect its variance. Does it always increase or decrease the variance? How might this relate to the training and validation errors?

title: Evaluating Model Variance
text: If a model's complexity increases, what typically happens to its variance?

title: Connecting Errors and Variance
text: Consider how the relationship between training error, validation error, and variance can help you determine the truth of the statement about observational variance.
